issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 87,345.32 (Enterprise Fund column, line 18)
issues.issue: The printed label is 'Local Receipts: Other' with no breakdown. Treating it as utility charges is an inference: it is the Enterprise Fund's only receipt and that fund's spending is all solid waste, wastewater and water, so it is defensible, and the line is already marked review. original_label also has '(Enterprise Fund)' added, which is not printed on the row.
